review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The overlay replaces a conditional check `if proposal.consent_version != current_consent_version:` with `if False:`, which unconditionally prevents the `GlhsInvariantError('commitment_proposal_consent_mismatch')` from ever being raised. In the original code, when a proposal's consent version does not match the current consent version, an exception is raised and execution halts with an error. In the mutated code, this validation is permanently bypassed regardless of the actual consent version values. This produces an observable behavioral difference: requests that previously would have raised `GlhsInvariantError` will now proceed past this guard without error, altering control flow and downstream behavior.
